item.title: Man faces kidnapping charge in Amber Alert case that started in North Las Vegas
item.description: A Las Vegas man faces charges including kidnapping after taking a 10-month-old girl from an apartment and threatening to kill her. The incident prompted an Amber Alert last week before the child was returned.

item.title: Sen. Rosen meets with Culinary Union on Las Vegas tourism slowdown
item.description: U.S. Sen. Jacky Rosen joined members of the Culinary Workers Union Local 226 on Friday for a roundtable discussion about tourism trends and how national policies could affect hospitality workers in Las Vegas.

item.title: Canadian tourist must remain in Las Vegas for alleged flamingo abuse
item.description: A Canadian tourist accused of stealing and torturing a flamingo at a Las Vegas Strip hotel must remain in the area as his criminal proceedings play out, a judge said Monday.
